Embeddings request against real OpenAI API

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\EmbeddingRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\EmbeddingRequest::from_json(json_encode(["input" => ["Hello world"], "model" => "openai/text-embedding-3-small"]));
$apiKey = getenv('OPENAI_API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('OPENAI_API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->embed($req);
var_dump($result->getData());
```
